newsitem.title: USA: WICOR Q4 manufacturing net cut by charge.
newsitem.headline: WICOR Q4 manufacturing net cut by charge.

text.p: WICOR Inc said Tuesday a one-time charge related to a product liability lawsuit and consolidation of two Wisconsin plants reduced its fourth quarter manufacturing earnings by $1.2 million, or $0.07 a share.
WICOR's manufacturing earnings for the quarter were $2.2 million on sales of $91.4 million, compared with year-ago earnings of $2.7 million on sales of $84.1 million.
Energy earnings for the quarter were $12.4 million, down from $14.3 million. Fourth quarter weather was six percent warmer than the year-ago period, WICOR said.
Overall earnings for the quarter were $14.6 million or $0.80 a share, down from $17.0 million or $0.99 a year ago.
